strategy.name: Moving Average Trend Following (Crossover & Pullback)
strategy.summary: Trade in the trend's direction: enter on a fresh EMA 20/50 crossover above EMA 200, or on a pullback into the EMA 20–50 'value zone'.

rules.text: Price is above EMA 200 and ADX(14) > 20.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was price above EMA 200 with ADX above 20?

rules.text: Variant A: EMA 20 crosses above EMA 50 → buy at candle close.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did EMA 20 cross above EMA 50 on the entry candle?

rules.text: Variant B: EMA 20 > 50 > 200; pullback between EMA 20 and 50, no close below EMA 50; buy when a bullish engulfing or pin bar closes above EMA 20.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the pullback inside the 20–50 zone with a bullish close above EMA 20?

rules.text: Short: mirror image (EMA 20 < 50 < 200, ADX > 20, bearish close below EMA 20).
rules.checklistQuestion: For shorts, were the EMAs stacked bearish?

rules.text: Stop 1 × ATR(14) beyond the swing, or beyond EMA 50.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop placed beyond the swing / EMA 50 as planned?

rules.text: At +1.5R close 50% and move the stop to breakeven; trail the rest.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you close 50% at +1.5R and move the stop to breakeven?

rules.text: No trade when ADX < 20 or EMA 200 is flat (< 0.15% change over 20 candles).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was ADX above 20 and EMA 200 sloping?
